prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / reusable 2D character animation asset.
Create ONE transparent-background PNG sprite sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR full-body wave poses of the SAME canonical bear, arranged in an exact 2-column by 2-row equal-cell grid. Aim for a square 2048x2048 canvas. There is ONE bear per cell, no duplicated extras. No drawn grid, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no background, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard, no glow.

The supplied PNG is the STRICT canonical identity reference, not a loose style reference:
pale-yellow body, coral-red beret with original shape/stem, warm brown outline, very large round head, large vertical oval brown eyes with clean white rims, small dark brown nose, original two smiling muzzle curves and the outer muzzle arch, pink tongue, round ears, short soft arms and short legs. NO cheek blush, NO human fingers, no clothes, no new accessories, no redesign into a generic teddy. Preserve the original head-to-body ratio and original facial proportions. Keep the face and smile IDENTICAL in all four cells.

Production constraints:
All four drawings have the same scale, same head size, same face, same torso and legs, same front-facing body, same feet baseline and same horizontal center WITHIN their equal-sized cell. Both feet remain flat in exactly the same position. Beret/head/body must NOT bob between frames. Leave generous transparent padding inside each cell; no paw, hat or outline may cross a cell boundary. Only the waving arm position changes. The other arm remains relaxed at the side.
This is an asset sheet for reusable limited animation, not a storyboard or illustration scene.

Cell order: top-left → top-right → bottom-left → bottom-right.
Frame 1 top-left: original neutral standing pose, both arms down, exact canonical proportions.
Frame 2 top-right: the arm on the VIEWER'S RIGHT is raised outward to shoulder level, paw naturally angled up.
Frame 3 bottom-left: same arm raised beside the ear/beret, paw gently angled toward the viewer.
Frame 4 bottom-right: same arm still raised beside the ear, paw tilted outward for the other phase of a gentle wave.
No detached limbs, no elongated arms, no motion streaks, no facial expression changes. Use a genuine transparent alpha background and preserve soft paper/watercolor fill inside the brown contours.
note: Raw transparent PNG copied unchanged to the shared library. Pixel analysis produced metadata only. No bitmap editing, video, animation playback or audio generation was performed.
